rca_of_issue: RCA (verified): react-native-svg extractGradient discards embedded alpha from stopColor and composes packed ARGB using stopOpacity (default=1), which turns rgba transparent/soft stops opaque when only stopColor is passed. Mitigation (verified by tests): split stopColor into opaque RGB + explicit stopOpacity and pass both props. Before pipeline produced alpha byte 255 for rgba(0) and rgba(.2); after pipeline yields expected bytes (0 for transparent, 51 for 0.2, 26 for 0.1 CTA). Physical device rendering remains unverified in this environment.
